title: IterSCI：Advances Autonomous Research with AI Workflow for Scientific Discovery-Nets Bay-From an exclusive perspective, comment and analyze international current affairs and international news
text:
The AI for Science platform connects literature review, experiment design, computational execution, data analysis, and research deliverables in a traceable workflow.
IterSCI is an AI for Science platform designed to help researchers move from research questions to executed experiments and scientific outputs. By connecting literature review, hypothesis development, experiment design, computational execution, data analysis, and research documentation, the platform aims to streamline the scientific research process.
From Research Questions to Executed Experiments
Scientific research often requires researchers to navigate multiple tools, review extensive literature, write and debug code, configure computing environments, and analyze experimental results. These disconnected steps can slow progress and make complex research workflows difficult to manage.
IterSCI brings these activities together in a connected workflow. The platform supports researchers in reviewing scientific literature, developing research hypotheses, designing experiments, executing computational tasks, analyzing results, and organizing research deliverables.
Making Scientific Workflows Traceable
Reliable scientific research requires more than plausible answers. Researchers need to understand how results were generated, inspect the underlying evidence, and evaluate whether conclusions are supported by experimental data.
IterSCI is designed to preserve execution records, experiment outputs, and research artifacts throughout the workflow. When computational experiments encounter errors, the system can support troubleshooting, code revision, and reruns, helping researchers inspect changes and evaluate the resulting outputs.
This approach aims to make AI-assisted research more transparent, traceable, and reproducible.
From Computational Experiments to Research Deliverables
IterSCI supports computational research workflows that bring together runnable code, scientific simulations, data analysis, visualizations, reports, and research documents.
For example, a computational science task can involve training a physics-informed neural network (PINN), monitoring its training process, visualizing simulated fields, and organizing the resulting figures and files for further analysis.
By connecting execution with analysis and documentation, IterSCI aims to help researchers move beyond isolated AI-generated answers toward structured, inspectable research outputs.
Building Infrastructure for AI-Driven Science
As AI becomes increasingly integrated into scientific research, the challenge extends beyond generating hypotheses or writing code. Research workflows also require execution environments, computing resources, experiment tracking, and reliable ways to organize and evaluate results.
IterSCI brings these elements together in a platform focused on end-to-end research execution. Its goal is to help researchers spend less time coordinating fragmented workflows and more time evaluating evidence, refining hypotheses, and advancing scientific discovery.
About IterSCI
IterSCI is an AI for Science platform focused on automating scientific research workflows. The platform connects literature review, hypothesis development, experiment design, computational execution, data analysis, and research deliverables, with an emphasis on traceability and reproducibility.
